question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    (
        -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-09-24
        -- Check if 25th birthday has occurred on or before 2026-09-24
        -- and 26th birthday is after 2026-09-24
        -- Using text comparison with proper date formatting
        (c.birth_date || '-00-00-00') <= '2026-09-24' 
        AND (c.birth_date || '-23-59-59') >= '2026-09-24'
        AND 
        (
            -- 25th birthday: birth_date + 25 years
            CASE 
                WHEN substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '02' AND substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = '29' 
                THEN (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25) || '-02-28'
                ELSE (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25) || substr(c.birth_date, 5)
            END <= '2026-09-24'
        )
        AND
        (
            -- 26th birthday: birth_date + 26 years
            CASE 
                WHEN substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '02' AND substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = '29' 
                THEN (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 26) || '-02-28'
                ELSE (CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 26) || substr(c.birth_date, 5)
            END > '2026-09-24'
        )
    );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.customer_id IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customers
    WHERE 
        -- Customer is exactly 25 years old on 2026-09-26
        -- Born on 2001-09-26 (25 years ago from 2026-09-26)
        -- Or born on 2001-09-27 (if 2001 was a leap year and they were born on Feb 29)
        -- But we need to check month and day exactly
        (birth_date = '2001-09-26')
        OR
        -- Handle leap year case: born on 2001-02-29 (doesn't exist, so no leap year issue)
        -- Actually 2001 is not a leap year, so only 2001-09-26 is valid
        (birth_date = '2001-09-26')
);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
    AND CAST(strftime('%m-%d', o.date) AS TEXT) >= CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT)
    AND CAST(strftime('%m-%d', o.date) AS TEXT) < CASE 
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT) = '02-29' THEN '03-01'
        ELSE CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT)
    END;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    -- Compute completed age exactly 25 on 2026-12-01
    -- Birth date anniversary: 25 years after birth_date must be <= 2026-12-01
    -- and 26 years after birth_date must be > 2026-12-01
    -- Using text comparison for dates in YYYY-MM-DD format
    substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS birth_date_formatted,
    -- Add 25 years to birth_date: if birth is 2001-12-01, then 25th anniversary is 2026-12-01
    -- So we need: birth_date + 25 years <= 2026-12-01 AND birth_date + 26 years > 2026-12-01
    -- Since SQLite doesn't have date arithmetic in this context, we can use:
    -- The customer must be born between 2000-12-02 and 2001-12-01 (inclusive) to be exactly 25 on 2026-12-01
    -- Because:
    -- - Born on 2001-12-01: turns 25 on 2026-12-01 (anniversary is on the day)
    -- - Born on 2001-12-02: turns 25 on 2026-12-02 (so on 2026-12-01, still 24)
    -- - Born on 2000-12-01: turns 26 on 2026-12-01 (so on 2026-12-01, just turned 26)
    -- So the valid birth dates are: 2000-12-02 to 2001-12-01 inclusive
    c.birth_date BETWEEN '2000-12-02' AND '2001-12-01';
